31/G.goal: Explain how somatosensory, haptic, smell, and taste senses can shape and be simulated in XR immersion.
31/G.achieves: Provides the learner with the foundation to recognize the non-visual and non-auditory channels available for XR immersion and their technical limitations, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing XR systems with confidence.

31/O1.goal: Explain the perceptual and technological basis of somatosensory and haptic immersion in XR.
31/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a foundation for connecting human touch and body perception with XR haptic-feedback technologies when understanding or implementing an immersive XR system.

31/O2.goal: Describe the possibilities and limitations of smell and taste simulation in XR.
31/O2.achieves: Helps the learner evaluate olfactory and gustatory channels as part of full XR immersion when understanding or implementing an XR system.
